Title: Marketplace improvements for Azure preview portal

Body.Content:
The following list itemizes Marketplace improvements for the Azure preview portal:
  • Updated New hub
  • Social sharing of Marketplace items
  • Improved pricing tier blade
For more information, see Announcing Azure Preview Portal Improvements (February Update).
